summary: Eight Pakistani soldiers were taken hostage by tribal militants in an ambush while on patrol in Serwakai, South Waziristan, Pakistan. The soldiers were killed on March 26, 2004, by the perpetrators.
Militants with suspected ties to al-Qaida launched rockets into the center of Peshawar, Pakistan. Two people were wounded in the attacks.
Al-Qaida attackers riding in vehicles drove close to Daimir checkpoint in North Waziristan (Pakistan) and lobbed grenades at security personnel injuring three of them.

A Pakistan army camp in the northwestern tribal area bordering Afghanistan came under rocket attack from suspected militants but there were no casualties. No group claimed responsibility for the attack.
A fierce gun battle between Pakistani security forces and Al-Qaida-linked fighters near the Afghan border left at least 24 people dead. There were no reports of injuries from the attack.
Two foreigners and a security man were killed in a shootout between foreign fighters and security agencies in South Waziristan. No group claimed responsibility for the attack.

Assailants opened fire on laborers working on construction of a Frontier Corps (FC) checkpost in Jamal Mai, Mamozai area, Upper Orakzai tehsil, Orakzai district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Two laborers were killed and another was declared missing. No group
Assailants opened fire and killed a Rapid Response Force Police Elite Force sub-inspector in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. No group claimed responsibility for the incident.

Rockets fired from Afghanistan at villages near the border killed a five-year-old child and wounded seven other children.
A roadside bomb hit an army patrol on the Inayat KilliLaghari road, killing two soldiers and wounding two.
A blast tore through a bus carrying workers to the Dasu hydropower project, killing 13 including nine Chinese nationals; later investigations pointed to explosives.
An IED exploded during a joint search operation near the Afghan border, killing two FC personnel and two police constables.
An improvised explosive device was triggered during a police patrol near Raghagan Dam, killing two policemen.
Firing from across the Afghan border targeted a Pakistani military post, killing five soldiers; TTP claimed responsibility.
A grenade attack in Peshawar killed four policemen; the TTP claimed responsibility.
A gunman opened fire outside the Imamia Shia mosque and detonated a suicide vest inside during Friday prayers, killing 63 and wounding nearly 200.
TTP militants attacked a security post, killing four Pakistani soldiers.
A member of a polio vaccination team and two security personnel were shot dead in Datta Khel.
An attack on a military convoy killed three soldiers and wounded seven people, including four civilians.
A terrorist attack on the Daraban police checkpoint killed a policeman and a civilian and wounded four policemen.
Gunmen opened fire on a vehicle, killing a Punjab police sub-inspector and a father and son, and wounding a child.
Detained militants seized a CTD compound and took hostages; a two-day siege ended with 25 militants killed and three soldiers dead.
Militants attacked the Sarband police station with guns and grenades, killing a DSP and two constables; the TTP claimed responsibility.
Terrorists stormed the Takhta Beg police checkpost with grenades and small arms before a suicide bomber detonated, killing three constables.
A suicide bomber disguised as a policeman detonated inside the Police Lines mosque during Zuhr prayers, killing 84, mostly police officers, and wounding 217.
Militants attacked a security post in Dirduni; six soldiers and three attackers were killed.
A remote-controlled bomb hit a vehicle carrying sand to a security checkpost, killing two people.
Two soldiers and two TTP militants were killed in an exchange of fire.
A roadside bomb killed two soldiers.
Three people were shot dead by unknown motorcyclists in Barang.
A suicide bombing at Ali Masjid killed one police officer.
A suicide bomber struck a Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F) workers' convention in Khar; at least 54 were killed and about 200 wounded, many of them children.
A suspected IED blast killed 11 labourers.
An ambush on a military convoy in Tiarza killed eight soldiers and wounded six.
A suicide bomber attacked a military convoy in Janikhel, killing 10 soldiers and wounding 18.
A suicide bomber on a rickshaw detonated at the Aslam checkpoint, killing four policemen, two security personnel and two civilians.
A suicide vehicle bomb struck a police station gate before dawn, killing at least 23 troops and wounding 32; part of the building collapsed.
An IED targeted a police truck carrying policemen for anti-polio duty, killing five and wounding 27.
Election candidate Rehan Zeb Khan was shot dead and three others wounded in a gun attack.
A terrorist attack on Chodwan police station killed 10 police officers and wounded six.
A militant assault on an army post in Mir Ali killed seven soldiers, including a lieutenant colonel and a captain.
A suicide bomber rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into a convoy of Chinese engineers near Besham, killing five Chinese nationals and a Pakistani driver.
An IED exploded near a security convoy, killing seven soldiers including a captain.
Gunmen fired on a vehicle near Kurram Bridge, killing an off-duty police officer and three family members and wounding a child.
Two suicide bombers and ten gunmen breached the cantonment perimeter; eight soldiers and at least three civilians were killed and about 140 injured. All ten attackers died.
A rickshaw-borne suicide bomb at the Aslam checkpoint killed four policemen, two security personnel and two civilians.
A suicide vehicle bomb destroyed the Mali Khel checkpost, killing 12 security personnel; six attackers were killed in the retaliation.
Gunmen ambushed a convoy of about 200 vehicles carrying Shia passengers between Peshawar and Parachinar, killing at least 54, including women and children, and wounding 86.
An aid convoy carrying essential goods to Kurram was attacked near Bagan; 10 people including six drivers, two passengers and two soldiers were killed.
Militants attacked the Raghzai security post in the Shaktoi area, killing five security personnel and wounding six.
A 64-vehicle aid convoy en route to Parachinar was attacked in three locations, killing nine including five security personnel, a driver and a passer-by.
Two suicide vehicle bombs breached the cantonment wall and gunmen stormed the base; five soldiers and 13 civilians were killed before all 16 attackers were eliminated.
A bomb exploded outside the office of a peace committee in Wana, killing seven people.
A suicide bomber drove an explosives-laden vehicle into a bomb-disposal MRAP convoy, killing 13 security personnel and wounding 16, including women and children.
An IED targeted the vehicle of Assistant Commissioner Faisal Ismail, killing him, a tehsildar, a subedar and two policemen, and wounding 11.
Security forces thwarted a suicide attack on the Federal Constabulary headquarters; six soldiers and five attackers were killed and 13 personnel wounded.
Unidentified assailants opened fire on a passenger vehicle in a suspected sectarian attack, killing seven.
An IED blast targeted a security forces convoy, killing six soldiers including a captain.
Militants ambushed the vehicle of Miranshah Assistant Commissioner Shah Wali, killing him, two policemen and a passer-by.
A suicide vehicle bomb rammed a joint security checkpoint, collapsing infrastructure and killing 11 security personnel and a young girl; seven were wounded.
A motorcycle-borne bomb exploded near a police station, killing two people and wounding 15.
Militants attacked a police station and a customs office, killing two officials and wounding two.
A motorcycle-borne suicide bomber targeted a security convoy, killing a lieutenant colonel and a sepoy; five militants were also killed.
Militants opened fire on an ambulance carrying wounded FC personnel after a drone attack, killing three security personnel.
An IED blast at a filling station and bazaar in Wana killed at least 10 people and wounded 31, including five policemen and 26 civilians.
A quadcopter drone attack on relatives of a police peace committee killed two people and wounded seven.
A car bomb destroyed the Fateh Khel police checkpoint, followed by a ground assault and drone attacks; 1521 police officers were killed and five wounded.
A bomb rigged to a rickshaw exploded in a bazaar, killing at least seven people including two policemen and wounding 23.
An explosives-laden vehicle attempted to enter a scouts camp; the blast killed eight security personnel and a civilian and wounded 35.
A would-be suicide bomber was stopped by villagers near a mosque; the device detonated, killing three people including a child and wounding five.
A suicide bomber detonated at the entrance of Kabal police station, killing 14 people, including police personnel, and wounding 18.
An explosives-laden vehicle detonated near the Police Lines mosque before gunmen stormed the compound; 15 policemen and eight civilians were killed and over 100 wounded.
A suicide bomber drove a tractor trolley into the Aman Mela police checkpost, killing 12 people and wounding 35; two rescue workers were shot dead at the scene.
A policeman was shot dead and two civilians wounded near a basic health unit in the Lowi Sam area of Khar.
